title: I replaced Spotify with a homemade FM radio station
raw_text:
Focusing on digital minimalism in its various forms.
Digital Minimalism: tranquility in the digital age.
RULES
- Don't be a jerk: There are real humans with real feelings behind the screen. Treat your fellow Redditors with respect.
- Screenshots: Screenshots are reserved for Declutter Monday threads (unless accompanied by useful information). Does not apply to comments.
- Lazy advice: Lazy advice such as just use "will power" and "self-control" are not welcome here. A better approach is to inform people how you developed those skills (e.g. meditation, deleting apps, installing apps, etc.).
- Digital Minimalism: Posts must be on the topic of digital minimalism
- YouTube: YouTube videos must have a text summary commented by the OP (Original Poster)
